technique: Repetition/flood padding — the email is stuffed with many repetitive, mundane, low-information reassurance sentences that bury the single load-bearing request ("check my account / match the reference") while making the message read like a long, harmless customer narrative, de-sensitizing the reader/agent to the one consequential line.
